raw.details:
Overview

Every flag takes you higher. Every challenge brings you closer to the apex.

APEX CTF — TECHNEX’26 is a multi-domain cybersecurity Capture The Flag competition organized by the ACM Student Chapter at SVPCET, Nagpur.

Designed to bring together aspiring ethical hackers, cybersecurity enthusiasts, programmers, and problem-solvers from across India, APEX CTF challenges participants to decode clues, uncover vulnerabilities, investigate digital evidence, and solve technical puzzles.

Every captured flag earns points, every challenge tests your skills, and every successful solution brings your team closer to the top of the leaderboard.

Event Overview

The competition consists of two rounds: an online qualifier followed by an on-site final round.

Round 1 — Online Qualifier

  • REGISTRATION IS COMPLETELY FREE!
  • Date: 9 December 2026
  • Time: 6:00 PM IST – 2:00 AM IST (10 December 2026)
  • Duration: 8 Hours
  • Mode: Online
  • Platform: CTF7
  • Registration Fee: FREE (₹0)
  • Eligibility: College students across India
  • Team Size: 2–4 Members
  • Format: Multi-domain Capture The Flag competition
  • Participants will solve cybersecurity challenges, submit valid flags, and earn points to climb the leaderboard.
  • The top-performing teams will qualify for the next round.

Round 2 — The Final Ascent

  • Qualified teams will advance to an on-site final round at SVPCET, Nagpur, during TECHNEX’26.
  • Further details will be shared with qualifying teams.

Community link for participants,join this for all updates : https://chat.whatsapp.com/D6Z204hsDB2CfXv3V8ItEI

Challenge Domains:

Participants can expect challenges across multiple cybersecurity and technical domains:

Cryptography (Crypto) | Web Security | Reverse Engineering (Rev) | Binary Exploitation (PWN) | OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence) | Steganography (Stegno) | Digital Forensics | Artificial Intelligence (AI) | Android | Linux | Networking | Circuit/Hardware | Miscellaneous Challenges

Team & Eligibility Guidelines

  • Open to college students from across India.
  • Each team must consist of 2–4 members.
  • Participants should register through Unstop.
  • Teams must follow the competition rules and maintain fair play throughout the event.

Competition Process

  • Registration: Teams register for free through Unstop.
  • Online Qualifier: Participants compete in the 8-hour CTF on the CTF7 platform.
  • Flag Submission: Teams solve challenges and submit valid flags to earn points.
  • Leaderboard Evaluation: Teams are ranked based on their competition scores and applicable tie-breaking rules.
  • Qualification: Top-performing teams advance to the on-site final round.
  • Flag format: APX

Rules & Guidelines

  • Participants must compete using their registered team accounts.
  • Flag sharing, unauthorized collaboration between teams, and unfair practices are prohibited.
  • Attacking the competition platform or infrastructure outside the intended challenges is strictly prohibited.
  • Participants must follow ethical cybersecurity practices and maintain sportsmanship.
  • Organizers reserve the right to disqualify teams for rule violations.
  • Write-ups may be requested for solution verification, and final results will be confirmed after the applicable verification process.

Judging Criteria

  • Leaderboard Ranking: Based on points earned through valid flag submissions.
  • Tie-Breaking: As determined by the official competition scoring rules.
  • Rule Compliance: Violations may result in penalties or disqualification.

Why Participate?

  • Test your cybersecurity skills through hands-on challenges.
  • Explore diverse technical domains and sharpen your problem-solving abilities.
  • Collaborate with your team and compete against students from across India.
  • Climb the leaderboard and earn your chance to reach the final round.

Are You Ready to Reach the Apex?

The code is waiting. The summit is calling.

Form your team, sharpen your skills, and prepare to capture the flags.

APEX CTF | TECHNEX’26

Organized by ACM Student Chapter, SVPCET, Nagpur.
